items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Dizzy was with Johnny Dankworth and Buck was with Humphrey Littleton and I worked with Chris Barber

ctx.x: Then I started to go to Europe. I got -- let's see, George Wein gave a party -- George Wein had now moved into New York and in his apartment he gave a party for Gerald Lascelles, the Queen's cousin, and he invited me to the party and I met Gerald Lascelles, and he was all over me, we were very good friends and he said, 'Oh, I have been following your records, ever since I was a young man,' and he said, 'We are going to have a big jazz festival -- now, this was about 16 years ago, we're going to have a big jazz…
Dizzy was with Johnny Dankworth and Buck was with Humphrey Littleton and I worked with Chris Barber, and Alex

Welch, it seems to me was on that thing. I didn't work with him but I met him and a year later, I -- oh, no, after I got back about a month later I wrote -- Harold Davidson had come backstage, that's right, and I told him I would like to work there as a soloist, so I sent him a letter and he sent back a very nice letter saying that I should get in touch with his man, Jack Higgins, which I did and so told Higgins I wanted to come over and work with the Alex Welch band as a soloist.
